title: This Voyage is Rated TC14
summary:
This Voyage is Rated TC14
The refined product imbalance between the United States and Europe is a structural blessing for trading companies and ship owners alike. Ship owners can increase the utilization of their assets with very little, if any, repositioning costs by securing cargoes both coming and going. Likewise, trading companies are able to capture arbitrage opportunities on top of existing contract movements.

children.title: Paper Covers Physical
children.summary: The backhaul trade had typically been opportunistic and seasonal in nature as incremental distillate was pushed out of the US Gulf coast. Today, the structurally long distillate position in the US Gulf has lent support to the steady volumes moving out of the region.

children.section_path_text: USG ‐ UKC Reported Spot Fixture Activity
children.summary: As domestic consumption in the United States continues to languish, it can be expected that new US refining capacity will push additional product into foreign markets. The growth of exports volumes plus the accessibility of freight paper markets could allow traders to take better advantage of market arbitrage opportunity mitigating the freight risk component of the transaction.
